'''pointy-eared green dude Wheelin' and Dealin' (Classic TDIGWATT)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[pointy-eared green dude]]
* '''Published:''' 16 August 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif|label=This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Deal dude DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Lando Calrissian (V), Captain Bewil (V), The Emperor (V), Black 2 (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), The Emperor's Prize (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

This is my first attempt at a classic Deal Deck.  I really need some help on further optomizing its capabilities.  Any help would be most gracious.

== Notes ==

* Original-era (V): Black 2 (V) (Virtual Set 1); Lando Calrissian (V), Captain Bewil (V), The Emperor (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), The Emperor's Prize (V) (Virtual Set 6).
* Secret Plans (starting section) dested as the Special Edition Effect, per precedent. No shields are started.

== Strategy ==

Once again, this is my first try at something like this.  I need to know what I need to cull out.  I keep looking at it, and for some reason, it just doesn't look great to me.  I've got some ideas on what I should/would/could do, but I'd like some feedback before I go and make changes.  I'd like to thank challenger...he sent me emails a few months ago going into great detail on how this deck should be played.  I've finally acquired the cards, and now I'd like to play it competetively.  Enjoy!

Is my character selection okay?

Should I find a way to put in Blaster Rack (v)?

Who should I drop from space?

Who should I drop from land?

What should I add?

Does the red look descent?

What aliens should I add?  (keep in mind it's classic!)

I know that in the end it is my choice on how my deck should be built.  But am I missing key ingredients?  Or is this okay?  About the only thing I'm fully confident in is the destiny of this deck!  (Avg 3.56, Avg 4.55 if Lando (v) on table!)  Thanks for any feedback and consideration towards this deck!

PEGD
